**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep both manifest ratchets compatible with the worker tree**

On this commit, the checked-in `RELEASE_MANIFEST.json` still contains 189 entries, but this assertion and its counterpart in `_c357_agents_ngoai_goi` now require 190. Both functions read that committed manifest directly, so both return `False` on the supplied tree; independently executing the same functions from the parent returns `True`. This breaks the selftest required by `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, even though the worker release-verification step correctly generates a temporary manifest. Make both ratchets inspect the generated worker manifest, or defer their increases until the land-side manifest update. Cover both worker and regenerated-land manifests in a regression test, retaining the exact-count check so unexpected package additions are still detected.
